race.comment: TERESPRIT (9) was again doing his best work late when rattling home from last to be beaten narrowly in second at Gundagai last start. Backs up quickly and will appreciate the bigger track, though will likely be settling at the tail of the field again. LORD OF VALOR (3) didn't give his rivals a sniff last start when leading pillar-to-post to take out his maiden. Can go on with it now and gets the benefit of a 2kg claim. BRUTAL FORCE (2) was well fancied last start over 1000m at this track when fifth. Gets a key switch in McDougall and is well-placed to make amends. BRASS MONKEYS (4) is yet to strike through this campaign but has turned in some good efforts and gets the key booking of Loy. Have to take seriously.
